description: Geographic part-of relationships, directed from a location to its containing geographic unit. US Zipcode-to-City relationships represent area overlap.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the relationship was created or last changed.

source_contributions.scope: First-level administrative divisions linked to their countries or territories. Excludes the United States and its Admin1 divisions; includes US territories with their own ISO2 codes, such as AS, GU, PR, and VI.
source_contributions.description: An Admin1 division belongs to the country or territory identified by its country-code prefix.

source_contributions.scope: US hierarchy: Zipcode → City/Place → County → State → Country. City/Place coverage is limited to places represented in zipcode overlap data; places without zipcode overlap are excluded.
source_contributions.description: Zipcode-to-City edges include “Outside city limits” pseudo-cities, which have no City-to-County edges. Only Zipcode-to-City edges carry overlap percentages; County-to-State and State-to-Country edges describe geographic containment.

properties.name: percent_of_zip_area_in_place
properties.description: Percentage of the zipcode area within the city or place. Present only on Zipcode-to-City edges; absent when missing from the source.

properties.name: percent_of_place_area_in_zip
properties.description: Percentage of the city or place area within the zipcode. Present only on Zipcode-to-City edges; absent when missing from the source.
